answer_1.quote: Through comprehensive experiments on safety, math, and code benchmarks, we demonstrate LED-Merging's robust performance in various safety-utility merging scenarios, ensuring safe responses while preserving essential domain-specific capabilities like mathematical reasoning and code generation.
answer_1.outputs: Generated code, mathematical reasoning solutions, and responses to safety queries

answer_2.quote: We assess safety-utility trade-offs through three pillars: (1) Safety via HarmBench and SORRY-Bench (Attack Success Rate, ASR↓). (2) Mathematical reasoning using GSM8K and MATH (Accuracy↑ with chain-of-thought. (3) Code Generation evaluated by MBPP and HumanEval-Pack (Pass@1↑).
